newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares rise in strong housing gains.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares rise in strong housing gains.

text.p: Popular realty firm Heliopolis Housing and Development closed 27 percent higher on Sunday, boosting share prices on the Egyptian stock exchange.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index closed 0.15 points higher at 286.95 on a volume of 34.25 million pounds ($10.07 million).
"Now is the best time to buy into the market. Foreign investors are out for the holidays," said Mohammed Abdullah of EFG/Hermes brokerage.
"It was an average day with Heliopolis pulling all the attention," he added.
Heliopolis was the most active share, jumping 94 pounds to close at 442.00 after trade worth more than 5.70 million pounds.
Some milling shares picked up after a poor end to last week.
"The mills are doing well as the date approaches for their dividend distribution which will be probably be within the next two weeks," Abdullah said.

East Delta Flour Mills closed 0.90 up at 53.50, South Cairo Flour Mills was 0.50 higher at 71.00, but Upper Egypt Flour Mills closed 4.30 lower at 64.25 while North Cairo Flour Mills slipped 0.24 to 131.01.
The CMAindex for openly traded firms rose to 429.04 from 427.17 on Thursday while the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 202.49 from 202.83.
From the 66 shares traded, 26 rose, 19 fell and 21 ended the day unchanged, the CMA said.
